shared_case_surface: public-safe comparison units whose workload, candidate/source digest, environment, treatment, evidence, acceptance, cache, and resource posture are explicit before any method row is compared
bounded_replacement_rule: A local replacement may add workload cases only when every method uses the same identity tuple, keeps unknown/null/excluded/unobservable/missing states explicit, preserves baseline visibility, and does not turn synthetic accounting into observed latency.
public_safe_requirements: raw session transcripts, private host fingerprints, and private runtime logs are not copied into the public bundle
candidate_or_source_identity and source_ref_or_digest are sha256 digests, so mutable labels cannot bind an observation
every observation evidence_ref resolves to a declared sha256-digested public-safe-observation artifact with an admissible public-safe evidence class
generated readers, validation receipts, and other derived surfaces cannot serve as observation evidence

matched reports preserve the exact identity tuple and digest-pinned evidence provenance for every admitted pair, with schema-bound one-to-one fixed-baseline bindings whose baseline and candidate methods belong to the enclosing unit, whose provenance covers both bound methods and no third method, whose identity evidence class is allowlisted and equal to every provenance class, and whose cardinality is bound to the six-method set
a positive report verdict requires a positive matched unit and observed-pair count

admitted units declare identity_match true, unmatched units declare identity_match false with zero pair counts and no bindings, and positive observed units expose baseline and a candidate method from an admitted binding for at least one canonical-unit metric
command.timeout_seconds is finite; non-finite literals and numeric overflow are rejected before admission
baseline and method rows share the complete identity tuple before comparison
cache posture and resource posture are explicit and known before an observed pair is admitted
first-failure, retry, and resource fields preserve unknown, null, excluded, unobservable, and missing states
only rows from an eligible pair populate observed_values or controlled_values; rejected rows remain visible through state counts and unmatched cases
synthetic or controlled values are accounted for separately and never reported as observed values
unmatched units and their mismatch reasons remain visible
a report cannot issue a universal winner, causal effect, central proof, or human-acceptance verdict
